7523.title: File-change lifecycle retains duplicate diff payloads
7523.rootCauseOneLine: Pi emits full file-change payloads at start and completion; ingestion stores both, and no pruning policy compacts the redundant started diff.
7523.proposedFix: Add witness-guarded post-completion file-change compaction after auditing timeline and log readers. No autopilot PR: changing persisted-event retention is outside the permitted simple-fix scope.
7523.caveats: Repeated in two clean source checkouts with synthetic pi events and real migrated SQLite; no live pi CLI or reporter database was used. The complete test is embedded in the HTML report.
